overview: This 396-page file documents U.S. assessments of Japan’s 1949 peace settlement and occupation, alongside reports on labor unrest, communism, party politics, public opinion, and Philippine attitudes. Its largest component is a detailed program explaining democratic local government, municipal administration, and civic participation in postwar Japan.
interest: Detailed local-government teaching papers sit alongside diplomatic assessments, revealing how occupation officials linked civic reform to Japan’s independence.
